story.titleZh: 法拉利车手将在巴西会面讨论墨西哥首圈争斗
story.summaryZh: 法拉利车队负责人瓦塞尔将在巴西召集勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿会面，讨论两人在墨西哥首圈激烈争斗导致维斯塔潘抢走可能胜利一事。汉密尔顿坚持批评勒克莱尔，并誓言“我永远不会被噤声”。
story.originalTitle: Ferrari drivers set for crunch meeting in Brazil
story.summaryEn: Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur will bring Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton together in Brazil to discuss their costly opening-lap battle in Mexico that allowed Max Verstappen to steal a likely victory. Hamilton doubled down on his criticism of Leclerc and vowed "I'll never be silenced".
detailZh: 法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦塞尔将在巴西召集他的F1车手们开会，讨论他们在墨西哥首圈代价高昂的争斗，同时刘易斯·汉密尔顿誓言“我永远不会被噤声”。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在墨西哥首圈激烈对抗，让马克斯·维斯塔潘抢走了法拉利认为很可能到手的胜利。
汉密尔顿赛后质疑勒克莱尔的比赛技巧，称他有一种“不成功便成仁”的心态，并且长期以来对队友拼得太凶。
法拉利认为他们的争斗越界了，车队负责人瓦塞尔周日晚上对Canal+表示，这是对法拉利员工“缺乏尊重”的表现。
据《The Race》了解，瓦塞尔计划周五在巴西让汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔坐在一起讨论此事。
墨西哥站比赛结束后，瓦塞尔分别与两位车手进行了单独交谈，但他计划在巴西所有人都在同一地点时安排一次正式的面对面会谈。
勒克莱尔周三宣布他与妻子亚历山德拉的孩子出生后，缺席了巴西周四的媒体日，因此无法在巴西大奖赛周末早些时候安排会议。
由于勒克莱尔缺席，周四只有汉密尔顿面对媒体，他在会上进一步强化了对勒克莱尔的批评。
当被问及是否同意勒克莱尔对他比对其他车手更狠时，汉密尔顿以勒克莱尔在新加坡站起步阶段放弃超越马克斯·维斯塔潘为例作对比，他回答说：“是的。”
他补充道：“我可以把你们看到的说出来。新加坡站，他完全轮对轮，完全在内线，在新加坡第一弯已经抢到领先，然后收油了。
“（对他们）肯定是不一样的。如果你看看队友之间的情况，和塞巴斯蒂安（维特尔）也是这样，和卡洛斯（塞恩斯）也是这样。”
汉密尔顿明确表示，他不会改变自己直言不讳的方式，包括在车队无线电里询问勒克莱尔是否因第一圈切弯而被处罚。
“我的评论被如何看待？我不知道。我真的不在乎每个人对我所说的话有什么感受，”汉密尔顿补充道。
“我喜怒形于色，当下有什么感受就说什么。我想有一件事我希望能……我确实看到有人说过，我说的那些话是经过算计的。
“我只想用这个事实来反驳：当你在比赛中时，你的心率大约在170（次/分钟）。你以每小时200英里的速度驾驶。你没有时间去算计自己说的话，去思考自己对媒体说的话。你不会想那些。
“通常你的沮丧会向车队里的人发泄，尤其是就决策向老板们发泄。而且赛事干事也一直要求我们在有……比如说，赛道上出现问题时发声。你被耽误了，被阻挡了，他们要求你把这件事说出来。”
举个例子，如果你看墨西哥站的一节练习赛，[伊萨克] 哈贾尔在1号弯的赛车线上减速让行，我当时什么都没说。他们也没有调查。如果当时我开口了，比如举起双手示意，他们就会调查，他就会因为阻挡而受罚。
所以重要的是确保自己保持开放。当然，有时候你说了些话，事后可能会后悔，但我不会。我永远不会为做真实、真诚的自己而道歉。我永远不会被噤声。
没有人要求我什么都不要说。事情就是这样。
汉密尔顿表示，他“非常努力地与夏尔建立良好的关系”，因为他知道勒克莱尔在为法拉利效力八年后“已经深深融入了车队”。
“我一直努力保持尊重，”汉密尔顿说。
“自然，像我这样的人加入一支车队并不容易，因为我非常直言不讳，我不断推动、推动、再推动，推动如此多的改变。而且我还会推动更多。只要我在这里，就会是这样。我来这里是为了赢。为了能够赢，你必须与身边的每个人合作。”
汉密尔顿坚称他“完全理解自己对车队的责任”，并表示他“一直努力表达对他们的感激，并竭尽全力帮助推动车队前进，我觉得自己是车队今天所处位置的重要一部分，这是积极的”。
他说他们“还没有时间坐下来全部面对面交流，因为弗雷德回到了马拉内罗，查尔斯回到了摩纳哥。
“但我们会坐下来谈一谈。我不认为所有问题都能在一次会议里解决。但这很重要。”
“我们现在打造的东西会让我们在明年处于正确的位置。从某些方面来说，我很高兴我们有过那样的经历。当然，我更希望赢下比赛并拿到一二名。但从那之中，你可以学到东西。”
“我真的相信明年我们能够为世界冠军而战。这是唯一的目标。所以现在，在幕后，我的重点是继续保持在最近几场比赛中在执行方面所取得的性能表现，然后致力于明年的赛车。”
“显然，除了推动他们之外，我对引擎无能为力，而他们会继续在幕后推动，我相信他们正在这样做。至于赛车，就是驾驭它，确保我们把它引向正确的方向。确保我们以正确的姿态迎接明年。然后弗雷德的工作就是确保我们所有人都朝着同一个方向前进。”
“当然，我们会奋力比赛。但要公平，并确保我们从中获得最大收益。”
汉密尔顿支持瓦塞尔，表示“我仍然相信弗雷德是带领我们夺得冠军的合适人选”。
当被问及他接下来想要什么时：“我认为关键在于沟通。关键在于理解。
“我还不太清楚。我试着想象过会议会是什么样子，会如何进行。我从来都不知道。”
“但我会做的是，确保我始终做真实的自己。对于我参与的任何部分以及我为车队做出的任何决定，我都不会回避责任。并且会继续努力推进。”
detailEn: Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur will get his Formula 1 drivers together in Brazil to discuss their costly opening-lap dice in Mexico, as Lewis Hamilton vows "I'll never be silenced".
Charles Leclerc and Hamilton fought each other hard on the opening lap in Mexico, allowing Max Verstappen to steal away what Ferrari believed was a likely victory.
Hamilton called into question Leclerc's racecraft after the race, saying he has a "do or die" mentality and a long history of fighting his team-mates too hard.
Ferrari felt that their battle crossed a line with team boss Vasseur telling Canal+ on Sunday evening that it was evidence of a "lack of respect" to Ferrari's employees.
The Race understands Vasseur is planning to sit Hamilton and Leclerc down together on Friday in Brazil to discuss the matter.
Vasseur spoke to both drivers individually after the race in Mexico, but he's planned a proper sit-down for Brazil when they're all in the same place.
Leclerc missed Thursday media day in Brazil after announcing the birth of his and his wife Alexandra's child on Wednesday, so a meeting earlier in the Brazil weekend wasn't possible.
With Leclerc absent, only Hamilton faced the media on Thursday, where he doubled down on his criticism of Leclerc.

Asked whether he agreed that Leclerc races him harder than other drivers, with the example of Leclerc backing out of passing Max Verstappen at the start in Singapore used as a comparison, Hamilton replied "Yes."
He added: "I can say what you see. Singapore, he was fully wheel to wheel, fully on the inside, had won the lead in Turn 1 in Singapore and backed off.
"Definitely [races them] different. If you look at the team-mates, it's the same with Sebastian [Vettel], it's the same with Carlos [Sainz]."
Hamilton made it clear he isn't going to change his outspoken approach, including over the team radio when he was asking if Leclerc had been penalised on lap one for cutting the track.
"How have my comments have been taken? I don't know. I don't really care how everyone feels about what I've said," Hamilton added.

"I wear my heart on my sleeve and I say how I feel in the moment. I think one thing that I would like to...I did see something that someone was saying that it's calculated, the things that I'm saying.

"I just want to combat that with the fact that when you're in the race, your heart rate is like 170[beats per minute]. You're driving at 200 miles an hour. You don't have time to be calculating what you're saying and thinking [what] you're saying to the media. You don't think about that.

"Usually your frustration comes out towards the people in the team, particularly the bosses about decisions. And also the stewards have always asked us to voice when we have…If there's an issue on the track, for example. You get held up, you get blocked, they ask you to voice it.

"An example is, if you look in Mexico, one of the practice sessions, [Isack] Hadjar, backed off on the racing line into Turn 1, I didn't say anything. They didn't look into it. If I had spoken, like throwing my hands up, for example, they would have investigated and he would have got a penalty, because it was impeding.

"So it is important to make sure you're open. Of course, there's some times you say things and maybe you might regret it afterwards, but I don't. I'm never going to apologise for being authentic and real. I'm never going to be silenced.
"I've not been asked to not say anything. And that's just the way it is."
Hamilton says he's "really worked hard to build a good relationship with Charles", knowing Leclerc is "very much embedded within the team" after eight years driving for Ferrari.
"I've always tried to be respectful," Hamilton said.

"Naturally, it's not so easy having someone like me come into a team because I'm very outspoken and I push and push and push, push for so many changes. And I'm going to be pushing for more. And as long as I'm here, that's how it's going to be. I'm here to win. To be able to win, you have to work with everyone around you."

Hamilton insists he "fully understands my responsibility to the team" and said he's "always trying to show my appreciation for them and my absolute utmost to help push the team forwards and I feel like I've been a big part of where we are today as a team, which is positive".
He said they "haven't had a time to sit down all face-to-face because Fred's been back in Maranello and Charles has been back in Monaco.
"But we will have a sit-down. I don't think everything's going to get squashed and sorted out in one meeting. But it is important.
"What we build now will put us in the right position for next year. And in some ways, I'm glad we've had that experience. Of course I'd rather have won and had a 1-2. But from that, you can learn.

"I really do believe that next year we can be fighting for world championships. That is the sole goal. So right now, in the background, my focus is on continuing to hold on to the performance we've picked up in the last few races in terms of execution and then working on next year's car.

"I obviously can't do anything about the engine, except for just push them and they'll continue to push in the background, I believe they are. With the car, it's steering it, making sure we steer it in the right direction. Making sure we arrive next year on the right foot. Then Fred's job is to make sure that we are all in the same direction.
"Of course, we're going to race hard. But fair and making sure that we get the maximum out of it."
Hamilton backed Vasseur, saying "I still believe Fred is the right guy to lead us to the championship".
Asked what he wants moving forward: "I think it's about communication. It's about understanding.
"I don't really know yet. I've tried to think of what the meeting will be like, how it's going to go. I never ever know.

"But what I will do is I'll make sure I'm always just authentically me. I won't back down from taking responsibility for any part that I play and any decisions that I make for the team. And just continue to push."
keyPointsZh: 瓦塞尔赛后对Canal+表示，两人的争斗是对法拉利员工“缺乏尊重”的表现。
瓦塞尔在墨西哥赛后已分别与两位车手谈话，但计划在巴西三人同处时正式坐下来讨论。
勒克莱尔因周三宣布孩子出生而缺席巴西周四媒体日，因此无法更早会面。
keyPointsEn: Vasseur told Canal+ after the race that their battle was evidence of a "lack of respect" to Ferrari's employees.
Vasseur spoke to both drivers individually after Mexico but planned a proper sit-down in Brazil when all three are in the same place.
Leclerc missed Thursday media day in Brazil after announcing the birth of his child on Wednesday, so an earlier meeting in Brazil wasn't possible.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
